instruction:
You are a structural fire engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-19 structural fire and tenability package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Structural fire engineering, tenability, egress, and fire-alarm workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run FDS, Smokeview, evacuation software, a structural fire model, or a real source-pack parser.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-19-LH-03`
- Fire strategy: `FIRE-19-STRAT-03`
- HRR design basis: `HRR-19-DESIGN-03`
- Steel member schedule: `STEEL-19-MEMBER-03`
- Tenability criteria: `TEN-19-CRIT-03`
- Egress and alarm basis: `EGRESS-19-ALARM-03`
- Fire engineering memo: `MEMO-19-FIRE-ENG-03`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Fire growth alpha | {{ fire_growth_alpha_kw_s2 }} kW/s2 |
| Time to check | {{ time_to_check_s }} s |
| Maximum HRR | {{ max_hrr_kw }} kW |
| Fire duration | {{ fire_duration_min }} min |
| Structural load ratio | {{ structural_load_ratio }} |
| Steel temperature | {{ steel_temperature_c }} degC |
| Visibility constant | {{ visibility_constant }} |
| Smoke extinction coefficient | {{ smoke_extinction_coefficient_m1 }} 1/m |
| Required visibility | {{ required_visibility_m }} m |
| Available egress width | {{ available_egress_width_m }} m |
| Occupant load | {{ occupant_load }} |
| Egress width factor | {{ egress_width_factor_m_per_10_persons }} m/10 persons |
| NAC current | {{ nac_current_a }} A |
| NAC capacity | {{ nac_capacity_a }} A |

## Checks

- Design HRR equals `min(fire_growth_alpha_kw_s2 x time_to_check_s^2, max_hrr_kw)`.
- Fire energy equals design HRR times duration in seconds divided by 1000.
- Steel critical temperature equals `39.19 x ln(1 / structural_load_ratio - 1) + 482`.
- Visibility distance equals visibility constant divided by smoke extinction coefficient.
- Required egress width equals occupant load times egress width factor divided by 10.
- NAC current margin equals NAC capacity minus NAC current.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when steel, visibility, egress, and NAC margins are non-negative; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated fire-model evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "design_hrr_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "fire_energy_mj": <numeric_value>,
  "steel_critical_temp_c": <numeric_value>,
  "steel_temperature_margin_c": <numeric_value>,
  "visibility_distance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "visibility_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "required_egress_width_m": <numeric_value>,
  "egress_width_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "nac_current_margin_a": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "structural-fire-tenability-package"
description = "SSC-19 structural fire and tenability metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound structural fire and tenability metrics from a deterministic SSC-19 task-owned source pack. The template combines fire growth HRR, fire energy, steel critical temperature, smoke visibility, egress width, alarm NAC current margin, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "structural"
category = "structural-fire-tenability"
standards = ["structural fire engineering workflows", "tenability review workflows", "fire alarm load workflows"]
tags = ["structural", "fire", "tenability", "egress", "steel", "alarm", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.fire_growth_alpha_kw_s2]
type = "float"
unit = "kW/s2"
description = "HRR-19-DESIGN-03 fire growth alpha"
min = 0.0469
max = 0.0469

[params.time_to_check_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "HRR-19-DESIGN-03 time for design HRR check"
min = 240.0
max = 240.0

[params.max_hrr_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "HRR-19-DESIGN-03 maximum capped HRR"
min = 2800.0
max = 2800.0

[params.fire_duration_min]
type = "float"
unit = "min"
description = "FIRE-19-STRAT-03 fire duration for energy check"
min = 20.0
max = 20.0

[params.structural_load_ratio]
type = "float"
description = "STEEL-19-MEMBER-03 structural load ratio"
min = 0.55
max = 0.55

[params.steel_temperature_c]
type = "float"
unit = "degC"
description = "STEEL-19-MEMBER-03 calculated steel temperature"
min = 420.0
max = 420.0

[params.visibility_constant]
type = "float"
description = "TEN-19-CRIT-03 visibility constant"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.smoke_extinction_coefficient_m1]
type = "float"
unit = "1/m"
description = "TEN-19-CRIT-03 smoke extinction coefficient"
min = 0.25
max = 0.25

[params.required_visibility_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "TEN-19-CRIT-03 required visibility"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.available_egress_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "EGRESS-19-ALARM-03 available egress width"
min = 8.4
max = 8.4

[params.occupant_load]
type = "float"
description = "EGRESS-19-ALARM-03 occupant load"
min = 320.0
max = 320.0

[params.egress_width_factor_m_per_10_persons]
type = "float"
unit = "m/10 persons"
description = "EGRESS-19-ALARM-03 egress width factor"
min = 0.2
max = 0.2

[params.nac_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "EGRESS-19-ALARM-03 NAC current"
min = 6.5
max = 6.5

[params.nac_capacity_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "EGRESS-19-ALARM-03 NAC capacity"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[outputs.design_hrr_kw]
description = "Design heat release rate"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fire_energy_mj]
description = "Fire energy over the design duration"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.steel_critical_temp_c]
description = "Steel critical temperature from load ratio"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.steel_temperature_margin_c]
description = "Critical temperature minus calculated steel temperature"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.visibility_distance_m]
description = "Visibility distance from extinction coefficient"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.visibility_margin_m]
description = "Visibility distance minus required visibility"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.required_egress_width_m]
description = "Required aggregate egress width"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.egress_width_margin_m]
description = "Available egress width minus required width"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.nac_current_margin_a]
description = "NAC capacity minus NAC current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when structural, tenability, egress, and NAC margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
